info.name: PureCloud Platform Textbots API
info.description:
With the PureCloud Platform API, you can control all aspects of your PureCloud environment. With the APIs you can access the system configuration, manage conversations and more.

Contact Support:
 Name: PureCloud Developer Evangelists
 Email: DeveloperEvangelists@genesys.com

item.name: Issue a bot flow turn event

variable.description: (Required) The bot flow session ID, typically obtained from 'POST /api/v2/textbots/botflows/sessions'

request.description: Send a turn event to an executing bot flow and produce the next action to take.

query.description: Include or exclude virtual agent flows, only applies to GenesysBotFlows or GenesysDigitalBotFlows
